originality.rationale: Primary full-text comparisons show Sharma 2026 establishes all-index congruence only modulo p^a for t=p^a (and modulo p² when a=1), whereas the final new claim determines a strict extra power for all a, exact maximum content, and the first obstruction coefficient. Han–Ono 2008 addresses simultaneous zeros at t=3. Six actual published-finding corpus semantic queries and seven targeted literature searches did not surface stronger exact coverage; absent indexing is explicitly a residual risk.

value.rationale: The complete positive content of the difference of two natural partition/hook-length series is an intrinsic global arithmetic invariant. The recent motivating theorem determines the modulus only up to p^a for non-prime primepowers and motivates higher lifting; a uniform sharp extra power with its exact first obstruction provides the natural complete answer, while acknowledging the published nonprimepower half.
